label: Solana DEX and Trading Infrastructure
summary: This cluster focuses on decentralized exchange solutions and advanced trading tools on the Solana blockchain, including liquidity aggregation, automated strategy execution, and perpetual markets.

representativeProjects.name: DEX Platform
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A multi-chain decentralized exchange providing unified liquidity and cross-chain asset trading.

representativeProjects.name: Dexter Finance
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A Solana-based DEX aggregator optimizing trading rates and liquidity through smart routing and Orca Whirlpools.

representativeProjects.name: Copyfi
representativeProjects.oneLiner: On-chain copy-trading platform that automatically replicates trades from successful wallets.

representativeProjects.name: PUNK
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Concentrated liquidity perpetual AMM on Solana providing high capital efficiency for pro traders and meme tokens.

representativeProjects.name: Atlas
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Automation platform and liquidity aggregator for Solana DEXs, offering arbitrage, limit orders, and modular SDKs.
